cohort_context: AIRO-signature mechanical hit ('stock for services' + 'material weakness' keyword co-occurrence in FY24 10-K). ALMU is a pre-revenue compound-semiconductor R&D shop (GaAs/InP-on-Si photodetectors for LiDAR, AR/VR, AI/quantum comms) headquartered in Goleta, CA with 11 FTE and a small cleanroom. FY24 revenue was $918,554 — of which $853,798 (93%) came from six federal contracts totaling $1,323,237 awarded by Navy/OSD/DOE. Forward +103.4% — catalyst rally. The prior framework run scored composite=0.000 and emit=False (correctly, by composite), but a SUB_MATERIAL_FEDERAL flag previously fired with MODERATE severity for the federal claim — that was wrong because for a $918K-revenue company $1.32M of fed contracts IS material; the size threshold is the wrong frame. The corrected calibration is UNVERIFIABLE-or-PASS when the named agencies + UEI both check out. This plan tests whether the framework's existence/federal/patent/H1B fingerprint cleanly resolves to PASS or to a real contradiction, rather than mis-firing on a $5M flat-dollar threshold designed for $500M-mcap companies.
